scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Last night of the graduation camping trip. The fire stretches four long shadows. Ringo's strumming an old guitar, Miles is adding wood to the iron pot; you look past the tent—the Teacher's sleeping bag is empty. Just wind.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The water bottle's still leaning against a rock, cap not screwed on tight. Getting water shouldn't take an hour. Trampled pine needles lead deeper into the woods, but there are no return footprints on top.

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: ...Something's wrong. Teacher went to get water. It's been an hour.

scenes.speaker: miles
scenes.text: I shouted toward the treeline twice. ...Nobody answered. Wind's too loud, maybe?

scenes.speaker: xian
scenes.text: There's nothing on the camera. Just static. ...No, wait. There's something over there.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: All four of them look at you at once. Night wind pours into camp, the fire's almost out. The guitar string's still vibrating, like a nerve pulled tight. Now you have to speak.

present.state: by the fire, guitar still in hand but not playing
near the tent line, camera at her side

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Convince your friends: drive back to the city right now to find Teacher
interactive.playerPrompt: What do you say to Ringo, Xian, and Miles?
suggestions: We can't wait anymore. Let's drive back to the city now.
Xian, what did your camera actually capture?
Miles, get everything in the RV. Ringo, when did you last see Teacher?
interactive.aiGoal: First decision point in the prologue. No matter what the player says, the group should ultimately agree to drive back to the city. Have Ringo/Xian/Miles respond if needed. Don't jump to adults disappearing or gunshots. When enough has played out, advanceMainline true.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Miles stuffs half-eaten cans into a cardboard box, Ringo kicks out the embers. Xian climbs into the back seat, camera pointed at the still-empty sleeping bag. She doesn't press the shutter.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The RV tires crunch over gravel. The campsite shrinks to a faint orange glow in the rearview. Ringo's at the wheel, Miles stares at the tree shadows outside, Xian curls up in back with the camera hanging from her neck.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You reach the city. Streetlights are on, shop doors stand open, traffic lights still cycling on schedule—and there's nobody on the streets. No adults. Not a single person. Like the whole city got muted.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Inside the convenience store, the freezer's still humming. A half-eaten bento sits on the counter, chopsticks stuck in at an angle, like the owner just stepped out back. Miles instinctively lightens his step, afraid to disturb this too-perfect emptiness.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The empty street stretches both ways. Shop doors hang open. Ringo waits by the RV. You could search for supplies—or stick with the group.

choices.label: Scavenge the pharmacy across the street
Stay with the group by the RV

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text:
You check the counter. Under a sticky notepad: a half-roll of gauze and a cold pack still sweating condensation.

[Found] Bandages · cold pack

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text:
Glass crunches underfoot. Most shelves are stripped—but one locked drawer gives way. A blister pack of antibiotics, still sealed.

[Found] Antibiotics ×1

scenes.speaker: ringo
scenes.text: ...Don't panic yet. Find a hospital first, or a pharmacy. As long as there's still medicine, we've still got options.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The empty city's silence presses down. Ringo's holding it together, Miles grips his backpack strap, Xian stares out the window. What to do next—that's your call again.

present.state: on the empty street, forcing a smile
beside the RV, backpack strap in hand
looking out the RV window with the camera

interactive.objective: [Current Objective] Decide your next move in the empty city: find a hospital, or scavenge supplies first?
interactive.playerPrompt: What are you going to do?
suggestions: Head to the nearest hospital and see if there's any medicine left.
Hit the convenience stores first—stock up on antibiotics and gas.
Have Xian use her camera to check for anything weird.
interactive.aiGoal: Empty city decision. Guide discussion toward hospital or scavenging, keep the tension up. Miles can remind them about supplies. Don't jump to gunshots or the radio tower. When enough has played out, advanceMainline true.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You leave the empty city and merge onto the highway toward the suburbs. Night hangs low. Static crackles through the radio on and off—like someone's talking from very far away.
